title: The Missed Jury Duty Call That Demands Gift Cards
hook: A caller says you missed jury duty. Then comes a demand for prepaid cards.
description: FBI IC3 warning, 17 September 2026: government impostors use missed jury duty and warrant threats and demand payments including prepaid cards. FBI guidance says officials will not call or text to demand payment. Sources: https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2026/PSA260917 and https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2023/PSA230929 . Recreated visuals are illustrations.

scenes.narration: A caller says you missed jury duty. Pay a fine now or face arrest.
scenes.heading: THE THREAT
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI documented this government-impersonation pretext in a 2026 warning.
scenes.heading: THE PRETEXT
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Caller ID can be spoofed. The caller may sound urgent and keep you on the line.
scenes.heading: THE PERFORMANCE
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The payment demand may be for prepaid cards. An FBI advisory also identifies gift cards as a method government impostors request.
scenes.heading: THE DEMAND
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The urgency is deliberate: it keeps you from checking whether the caller has any authority at all.
scenes.heading: THE TURN
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI says law enforcement and government officials will never call or text demanding payment this way.
scenes.heading: THE FACT
items: Official agencies do not demand cards
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Hang up. Find the court or agency's number yourself and verify independently. If you paid, contact your financial institution and report it at IC3.gov.
scenes.heading: THE RULE
scenes.label: Illustration

notes: FBI IC3 17 September 2026 PSA documents missed-jury-duty threats, caller spoofing, prepaid-card demands, and official independent verification guidance.
FBI IC3 2023 Phantom Hacker PSA explicitly includes gift/prepaid cards as an imposter payment method.
No actual caller, court, card brand, loss amount, or quote is presented as a documented incident.
